wikitext.*:
Tags are aspects of food that each ingredient, beverage, and dish have. 

Ingredients on a dish come in four categories:

* Pink tags are inherently part of a dish, and are automatically present.
* Orange tags are retroactively added through ingredients, applying every tag on it.
* Strikethrough blue tags have been cancelled out by another tag, which takes priority above it. For instance, the ''Meat'' tag overrides ''Vegetarian'': if both are present, ''Vegetarian'' is struck through and no longer counts. The complete list of tag priorities is:
** ''Meat'' > ''Vegetarian''
** ''Large Portion'' > ''Small Portion''
** ''Filling'' > ''Good with Alcohol''
** ''Greasy'' > ''Mild''
** ''Hot'' > ''Refreshing''
* Black tags are forbidden: adding the same orange tag will turn the dish into [[Dark Matter]]. However, if [[Medicine Melancholy|Medicine]]'s reward spell card is in effect, the black tags will have no effect on the dish.

Beverages only have blue tags (which behave identical to the pink tags on dishes), as they cannot have tags added to them in any way.

Each Kitchenware has a tag, which applies to every dish made with it - these tags are not asked for and are not shown on the dish itself, used only for searching in the Album.

There are, additionally, two Trend tags, ''Trend - Popular'' and ''Trend - Unpopular.'' The two vary from time to time: they are attached to tags depending on the current date, and will be applied alongside them. The currently active Trend tags are not explicitly shown, but one can follow the newspaper in the album to keep track.

Cooking on the [https://touhou-mystias-izakaya.fandom.com/wiki/Kitchenwares#Night_Sparrow_Series Night Sparrow set] technically counts as a tag of its own (labelled as ''Utensil「Night Sparrow」''in the files), which is added to any dishes cooked on the set with a perfect Sparrow Tune or with Hyper mode on. Dishes with the tag ignore the specific tag requests of [[Customers|Rare Customers]].
